subject: Level-number
notes: All three special-level assignments, each with its own witness: GR2a (77 may be used only as described by the data description format) by a 77 written as a renames entry; GR2b (66 only as the renames format) in BOTH directions -- a 66 with no RENAMES clause and a RENAMES body at another level, the latter of which reached the emitter and produced uncompilable C# before this screen; GR2c (88 only as the condition-name or validation format) by an 88 carrying a PICTURE. The format is read from the entry BODY and never from the level-number, or every one of these rules would be vacuous. kb/Work PB485.
